Hints: Even numbers are integers exactly divisible by 2, leaving no remainder.
Solution: Four objects make 2 complete pairs: 4 = 2 x 2. There is no leftover, so 4 is even.

Hints: Odd numbers are integers not divisible by 2, leaving a remainder of 1.
Solution: Nine objects make 4 pairs with 1 leftover: 9 = 2 x 4+1. Thus 9 is odd.
